representation.declared: RAW3 triplet exactly as the frozen loader serves it: RoboTwin HDR-derived three-channel float32 measurement in its own scale, no /255, no per-frame max, no ISP

model.disclosure: ConvNeXt V2-Base (depths 3/3/27/3, dims 128/256/512/1024) raw backbone initialised from scratch, no RGB weights and no RGB teacher; the 1x1 per-level projection to d_model and the inference proposal/corrector layers are the disclosed new layers; the readout is the ported Perceiver IO core

data.normalisation: loader statistics only, RoboTwin checkpoint rule MEAN_STD; the training entry never normalises or de-normalises actions (prepare_control_targets pads to 32 dims, control_actions slices back)

protocol.action: actions[t] is the current 14-dim online joint vector (left 6 joints, left gripper, right 6 joints, right gripper)
protocol.unit_note: the cached 16-dim robot_states is NOT the online 14-dim joint state and never enters the policy

aux.noise_note: the official RoboTwin cache declares no sensor noise model, so the noise term stays off and no target is invented

loop.profile_note: profiled on the deployment host before the long run: 25-update pilot at microbatch 1 anchor / grad_accum 1 gave 2.73 s per update (p50 2.53, p95 3.26) and 59.5 GB peak GPU; the run therefore uses microbatch 1 anchor with grad_accum 2 (effective 2 anchors per update, about 5.5 s per update, 1000 updates about 1.5 h) and one process per GPU. The 200-update profile run recorded the chosen setting's real time and memory in its own run directory.

runtime.gpu_note: one process per GPU: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 for this RAW arm, in-process device cuda:0
